messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: genqueue errors detected in eu-west-2 affecting model inference retries. Pager routed to on-call (maya). Incident ID INC-2026-03-17-01.

maya: oncall here, acked. I'm pulling logs now and will 1) confirm blast radius 2) set an ETR. tagging leah to own statuspage copy unless someone else prefers.

leah: I can take initial statuspage draft + publish coordination. who will be the on-call anchor for customer Qs? we should also appoint a customer observer to monitor support channels.

maya: i'll be anchor for technical questions. asaf, can you be customer observer and coordinate with support for impact statements?

asaf: yes I'll watch support threads and surface any customer-reported errors. drafting initial public copy below — please review quickly.

asaf: ```Initial update (v1): We’re investigating increased error rates for generation requests in eu-west-2. Some requests may fail or experience retries. Our engineers are actively investigating. We will post updates every 15 minutes or as new information is available. Inc ID: INC-2026-03-17-01.```

legal-ci: quick note — avoid using words like “outage” or assigning blame. keep to factual impact (what customers see). also no SLA claims yet.

leah: updated draft with legal tweak and an impact bullet: ```Impact: A subset of generation requests from eu-west-2 may see failures or increased latency. Customers with pinned Dedicated capacity should see limited effect; Hosted API customers in eu-west-2 may be more affected.```

frank: can we get a quick estimate on percentage of requests failing or sample error rates to include? ops needs a number.

maya: current telemetry: error rate spiked to ~7% for gen endpoints in eu-west-2 at peak, now trending ~4.5%. rolling mitigation in progress (restarting genqueue workers). ETR: 45–60 minutes to validate stabilization.

asaf: adding that stat to the public copy: ```Current status: Error rate peaked at ~7% and is now ~4.5%. Mitigation: restarting genqueue workers; stabilization expected in 45–60 minutes.```

leah: publishing cadence proposal: initial publish now, then updates at +15m, +30m, +60m, and resolved notice. ops-publisher-bot will make the statuspage post after I paste final copy.

ops-publisher-bot: ready to publish on request. please paste final copy and confirm permissions (leah, maya, ops-publisher-bot).

leah: final copy below — please :eyes: and say :thumbsup: if good to publish.

leah: ```PUBLIC UPDATE (15:22 UTC): We are investigating increased error rates for generation requests in eu-west-2. Some requests may fail or experience retries. Current status: Error rate peaked at ~7% and is now ~4.5%. Mitigation: engineers have restarted genqueue workers and are monitoring. Estimated time to stabilization: 45–60 minutes. We will provide updates every 15 minutes or sooner as we learn more. Incident ID: INC-2026-03-17-01.```

maya: :thumbsup: from on-call. asaf is monitoring support; notify if any major customer reports.

asaf: noted — I'll surface any support tickets that indicate customer-visible impact (e.g., retries causing failures in production).

frank: thanks. ops, include the error-rate numbers in the internal post so SREs can correlate with dashboards.

leah: publishing now. ops-publisher-bot, publish using channel statuspage:incidents and mark initial update.

ops-publisher-bot: published initial update to Status Page (post id sp-1776543210-1). Next update scheduled +15m.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager reassigned to followup rotation (maya -> leah). Please keep this thread as the canonical comms thread for edits to public copy.

(45 minutes later)

maya: update: error rate steady at ~1.2% after mitigation, continuing to monitor. moving ETR to now ~15 minutes to confirm stable.

asaf: no major customer-impacting tickets so far, mostly retries that resolved behind the retry logic. one small customer reported increased latency — we've reached out.

leah: publishing 30m update with stabilization numbers and timeline. draft: ```UPDATE (15:37 UTC): Error rates have decreased to ~1.2% following mitigation actions. We continue monitoring for full stabilization. Estimated time to resolution: ~15 minutes.```

ops-publisher-bot: published update sp-1776543210-2.

(1h later)

maya: resolved: genqueue workers healthy, error rates back to baseline ~0.1%. no ongoing customer impact observed.

leah: final resolved notice draft: ```RESOLVED (16:22 UTC): The incident impacting generation requests in eu-west-2 has been resolved. Error rates are at baseline and systems are stable. If you are still experiencing issues, please open a support ticket and reference INC-2026-03-17-01.```

ops-publisher-bot: published resolved notice sp-1776543210-3. Incident marked resolved in internal tracking.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-17-01 RESOLVED. Thank you to the on-call and ops teams for rapid mitigation.
